data.one_liner: Provides generated Dart classes with comprehensive country data and utilities.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a Country enum with fields like ISO codes, phone prefixes, currencies, and flag emojis. It also offers helper methods such as getting short names by locale and printing all countries.
use_when: You need an offline, static list of country information.
You want flag emojis and locale‑specific short names without network calls.
avoid_when: You require up‑to‑date data that changes frequently.
You need subdivision details (now in a separate package).
weaknesses: Large static data increases app size
No runtime updates; data is fixed at compile time
